metrics.label: P/E
metrics.description: Price-to-Earnings: Price per share divided by earnings per share. Shows how much investors pay for $1 of profit.

metrics.label: EV/EBITDA
metrics.description: Enterprise Value divided by EBITDA. Measures valuation relative to operating cash earnings.

metrics.label: Price/Book
metrics.description: Price per share divided by book value per share. Compares market value to net assets.

metrics.label: AUM
metrics.description: Total assets managed by the ETF

metrics.label: Holdings
metrics.description: Number of securities held in the fund

metrics.label: Top 10 Weight
metrics.description: Percentage of the portfolio allocated to the top 10 holdings

metrics.label: NAV
metrics.description: Net Asset Value per share of the ETF
